# Restrict SSH / NETCONF to the configured mgmt subnets.
# These 'set firewall' lines define the filter in the candidate config.
# Activate it by uncommenting the 'set interfaces lo0 …' line below
# after reviewing — a misapplied lo0 filter can blackhole BGP / OSPF /
# IS-IS to the RE.
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.1/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 10.0.0.0/8
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 203.0.113.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from source-address 192.0.2.64/26
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt from destination-port [ ssh 830 ]
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-mgmt then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt from destination-port [ ssh 830 ]
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-mgmt then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 192.0.2.1/32
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term permit-snmp then accept
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from protocol udp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp from destination-port snmp
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then log
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term deny-snmp then discard
set firewall family inet filter MGMT-ACL term default-accept then accept
#
# tcp port 830 (NETCONF over ssh, Step 6) is permitted by the same terms as ssh.
# udp port 161 (SNMP, Step 5) is accepted from the SNMP clients only; this is the source restriction
# under SNMPv3, which the client list of Step 5 does not give.
#
# Apply (review first):
# set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input MGMT-ACL
